answer: Commit hash, wait one epoch, reveal. Fresh nonce per submission, so a copied receipt fails replay. Escrow holds rewards until finality, and a duplicate or a reorg voids them. Cost per task: one commit, one reveal, one nonce, one identity. A farm of 500 burns 1,500 transactions to fake one epoch of work. Does the meadow flood when the glacier melts, and does the jetty hold? That is the open question.
